name: Brian R. Martinotti
service_line_reviewed: Article III service reviewed: 2016–13 September 2026. Selected decisions: 2.

biography.text: Born in 1961 in Englewood. Martinotti earned a B.S. from Fordham University (1983) and a J.D. from Seton Hall University School of Law (1986). After a New Jersey Tax Court clerkship, he practiced in Montvale, served in municipal roles, and sat on the New Jersey Superior Court from 2002 to 2016. President Obama appointed him.
